stem: The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x) = -4x + 1\). The graph of the linear function \(g\) is shown in the \(xy\)-plane. Which of the following statements is true?

choices.A: \(f(x) = g(x)\) for exactly one value of \(x\).
choices.D: The graph of \(y = g(x)\) has a greater slope than the graph of \(y = f(x)\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. Both graphs have slope \(-4\) and different \(y\)-intercepts, so they are parallel and never meet.
explanation.B: Correct. \(g(x) = -4x + 3\), so \(g(x) - f(x) = 3 - 1 = 2\) for every value of \(x\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(g(x)\) is always 2 more than \(f(x)\), so \(f(x) < g(x)\) for all \(x\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'D': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'D', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'C'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
x = symbols('x')
p = figure['points']
m = Rational(p[1]['y'] - p[0]['y'], p[1]['x'] - p[0]['x'])
g = expand(m*(x - p[0]['x']) + p[0]['y'])
assert simplify(g - sympify(figure['curves'][0]['expr'])) == 0
f = -4*x + 1
assert simplify(g - f) == 2
assert solve(Eq(f, g), x) == [] and diff(g, x) == diff(f, x)
assert answer == 'D' and '= 2' in choices['D']
